item.title: App for beekeepers
item.description:
App for beekeepers

Upcoming app for beekeepers

Track your bees, take notes and manage your hives locally. An app designed specifically for Norwegian beekeepers and our conditions.

Free for Norwegian beekeepers

The app will be free for all Norwegian beekeepers. Coming soon to Google Play and the App Store.

Features

  • Hive activity tracking
  • Notes and observations
  • Local data storage
  • Tailored for Norwegian seasons and conditions

Stay tuned — the app launches soon!

item.title: Beekeeping
item.description:
Beekeeping in Bergen

Free Swarm Collection

Got a swarm? I’ll come and take it away for free! Call me at +47 926 20569 if you discover a bee swarm in the Bergen area.

Pollination Services

Need bees for your farm? I can bring bees for pollination of fruit trees and crops. This helps both your plants and my bees.

Handcrafted Beehives

I make sturdy beehives from solid wood. Each beehive is built to last and give the bees the best home.

item.title: Contact
item.description:
Contact

Want to collaborate or learn more?

Feel free to get in touch! I’m always interested in new projects, collaborations, and sharing knowledge about crafts, farming, and beekeeping.

Contact Information

Email: info@wenzel.no
Phone: +47 926 20569

From Bergen

Based in Bergen, Norway. I work locally and prioritize short-distance solutions and community engagement.

I’m happy to answer questions about beekeeping, farming, crafts, or collaboration projects.

item.title: Farm
item.description:
Farm

Chicken Farming

I raise happy chickens and share their eggs with the community. My chickens live freely and receive the best care.

Egg Hatching

Got a coop? I can provide eggs for hatching and help you start with your own chickens.

Collaboration

Let’s work together - you raise chickens, I’ll supply eggs. Together we can create a strong local community around farming.

Community Focus

My farm is about more than just production - it’s about sharing knowledge, resources, and creating connections in the local community.

item.title: Oyster Mushrooms
item.description:
Oyster Mushrooms

Growing Oyster Mushrooms

I cultivate oyster mushrooms with care and love. Each mushroom gets time to develop naturally for the best possible taste and quality.

Forest Integration

Find my wooden stump in the woods with a QR code linking here! This is a unique way to connect nature with technology.

Community Idea

Picked some mushrooms? Support my work if you like it. This is about sharing nature’s gifts with the local community.

item.title: Tourism Items
item.description:
Tourism Items

Handcrafted Laser-Cut Items

I create unique souvenirs like plant stands, decorative maps, and custom designs. Each item is made with care for Bergen and our visitors.

Bergen-Inspired Designs

My designs reflect Bergen and the local environment. From maps of our beautiful areas to functional items like plant stands - all made with love for tourists and locals.

Product Examples

  • Decorative maps of Bergen
  • Plant stands in unique designs
  • Custom souvenirs
  • Special designs like “brigišky” and “gunlehalte”

See the photos to get a feel for the craftsmanship and quality.
